protocol.inputs: Only four original released 211-Angstrom images per forecast. All new candidates and controls have identical fitting/evaluation rows and original fit-block labels. No wind-speed history as a predictor, recurrence data, EVE or external imagery.
protocol.development: Four training-side folds: for each fold in the bank, fit the other three and evaluate that fold. Per-split image centering, normalization and scalers use fitting folds only. Same original training offsets6..18/evaluation offsets6..19. Fold5 bytes are hash-checked and discarded without parsing or retaining them in the development worker. Do not read/import F1 final results, released WindNet forecasts, old full-data bundles, or test-case analyses in development. Hypotheses derive only from training-side outcomes and source/metric definitions. Earlier published test scores are already known to this conversation and cannot be made unseen.
protocol.final: Only after strict training-side adoption and a stability check, freeze exact source/recipe/data identities, then make one separate matched historical five-fold evaluation. No test feedback may determine model choice or a subsequent hypothesis. Report continued prior exposure and sequential-testing limits; never call this a fresh blind confirmation.
protocol.metrics: Mean fold RMSE km/s, Fisher-z averaged fold Pearson r (paper aggregation), arithmetic mean r also disclosed, reduced chi-square using original target sigma, mean fold HSE threat score using original HSEcalc. MAE and 500/600 threshold metrics secondary. Report undefined metrics explicitly. Paper baseline distinct from any modern port.
protocol.success: Require a candidate to beat BOTH training-side controls on all four aggregated metrics: mean-fold RMSE <=.99*the lower control RMSE; Fisher r >=the higher control r+.005; mean reduced chi-square <=.995*the lower control chi-square; mean original HSE threat score >=the higher control TS+.02. Undefined scores fail. Record all candidates, metrics and ablations; no single-metric promotion.
protocol.stopping: Continue inside the original US$5 cumulative estimated Runpod envelope; prior phase conservative estimate US$0.50672. Track live worker cost and download evidence before deleting only resources created for this phase.
protocol.prior_exposure: Published historical holdout scores were already in this conversation before this request. This campaign is prospectively sealed against further test feedback, not a pristine blind or fresh confirmatory study.
protocol.publication: User explicitly authorized public RogNet campaign/experiments and commits pushed to GitHub. Dashboard remains owner-private by default.

experiments.label: M1
experiments.observation: Best ridge RMSE74.46,r.551 versus matched LSTM71.66,r.591. Gate failed; incumbent retained.
experiments.hypothesis: Regularized linear temporal heads can beat the matched LSTM.
experiments.method: 18 ridge configurations and three LSTM seeds; identical image windows.
experiments.title: Original image embeddings and regularized temporal heads

experiments.label: M2
experiments.observation: Best raw kernel RMSE75.35,r.538. No mixture passed; baseline retained.
experiments.hypothesis: Nonlinear kernels can improve the frozen embedding forecast.
experiments.method: 45 kernel configurations and five fixed mixtures; common rows.
experiments.title: Nonlinear kernels on the same frozen image embeddings

experiments.label: M3
experiments.observation: Removing sequence loss improved RMSE by 0.55%, below the 1% gate, and reduced HSE threat score. Incumbent retained.
experiments.hypothesis: Removing auxiliary or variance loss terms improves accuracy.
experiments.method: Three loss conditions, each with three identical seeds; matched architecture and rows.
experiments.title: Matched loss ablations for sequence and variance terms

experiments.label: M4
experiments.hypothesis: Spatial dark-area summaries preserve coronal-hole location and complement pooled embeddings.
experiments.method: 48 ridge/tree candidates, fixed mixtures and matched energy-only/spatial-only/combined feature ablations.
experiments.observation: RMSE 70.32 km/s and r 0.613 passed the two-metric validation gate. Chi-square and event threat score worsened; no all-metric improvement claim.
experiments.title: Coronal-hole spatial summaries and feature ablations

experiments.label: M5
experiments.title: Mean-normalized fast-wind weighting
experiments.observation: Weight 4 improved event threat score and chi-square but worsened RMSE and correlation. No balanced adoption.
experiments.method: Two mean-normalized weighting conditions, three seeds each, and fixed mixtures with the spatial candidate.
experiments.hypothesis: Mean-normalized fast-case weights can improve event skill without losing trajectory accuracy.
experiments.success_criteria: Require RMSE gain, nondecreasing correlation, no worse chi-square or HSE threat score.

experiments.label: M6
experiments.title: Amplitude calibration and validation stability audit
experiments.observation: Gain 1.2 on the spatial mixture passed the balanced gate: RMSE 70.23 km/s, r 0.613, chi-square 26.56, event score preserved. Conditional intervals include no improvement.
experiments.method: 280 fixed amplitude calibrations and 2,000 paired whole-block bootstrap draws on validation only.
experiments.hypothesis: Positive amplitude calibration can restore event amplitudes while preserving correlation.
experiments.success_criteria: Require all four metrics to meet the predefined balanced guard.

experiments.label: F1
experiments.title: Frozen image-only comparison on original WindNet folds
experiments.observation: Frozen primary RMSE 76.77 versus 80.28 km/s, Fisher r 0.566 versus 0.550, and reduced chi-square 26.43 versus 26.83. HSE threat score fell from 0.200 to 0.179; strict four-metric gate failed. No test-driven model changes.
experiments.method: 16 frozen model recipes and ablations, all original five folds, identical 2,198 test windows. All fits and checkpoints finish before scores are reported.
experiments.hypothesis: The validation-selected image-only recipe may improve the original paper metrics on the same test windows.
experiments.success_criteria: Fixed primary must improve RMSE and Fisher correlation; strict four-metric improvement is reported separately.

experiments.label: M7
experiments.title: Training-bank controls and aligned future supervision
experiments.hypothesis: Aligning auxiliary targets to the forecast horizon may improve trajectory and event skill without new predictors.
experiments.method: Four training-side CV splits; retrain both prior controls. Four controlled future-supervision losses with identical data, architecture, seeds and fixed epochs.
experiments.success_criteria: Beat both controls on all four training-side metrics: at least 1% RMSE reduction, +0.005 Fisher r, 0.5% chi-square reduction, and +0.02 HSE threat score.
experiments.observation: No aligned-target condition passed. Some lowered chi-square, but RMSE, correlation and HSE threat score failed the balanced gate.

experiments.label: M8
experiments.title: Fixed mixtures, feature ablations and four-metric calibration
experiments.hypothesis: Diverse supervision and spatial image features may complement one another and yield a balanced four-metric gain.
experiments.method: 24 fixed bases and 49 amplitude/bias settings each; 1,176 training-bank configurations. Same rows, images and folds; both prior controls retained.
experiments.success_criteria: Beat both controls on every metric using the predeclared margins. No single-metric adoption.
experiments.observation: No configuration passed all four requirements. Gate pass counts: RMSE 139, r 0, chi-square 410, HSE threat score 244 of 1176; no model adopted.

experiments.label: M9
experiments.title: Location-preserving pretrained feature maps and weighted ridge ablations
experiments.hypothesis: Local pretrained activation energies may retain solar-disk geometry that global pooling loses, improving the training-side correlation ceiling.
experiments.method: Two fixed 4x4 spatial representations, three temporal views, five ridge penalties, two fitting weights; 60 raw recipes plus 2880 fixed mixtures/calibrations. Same original images and rows.
experiments.success_criteria: Beat both controls on all four metrics using the preregistered margins, then pass a training-only stability check.
experiments.observation: One of 2940 configurations passed all four training-side gates: RMSE78.55, Fisher r0.567, chi-square27.02, HSE_TS0.280. The event gain has positive conditional intervals against both controls; other gains remain uncertain versus priorM6. Stability must be checked before freeze. Subsequent preregistered stability screen passed only2/4 leave-one-fold-out checks, so this isolated candidate was not frozen.

experiments.label: M10
experiments.title: Variance-weight sensitivity and stability of location-preserving forecasting
experiments.hypothesis: Fit-side precision weights may improve balanced margins and make the isolated M9 validation pass stable across training folds.
experiments.method: 45 raw location ridge recipes and 3600 mixtures/calibrations, same images and rows. Require all four gates, 3/4 directional leave-one-fold-out passes, no fold RMSE loss above5%, and positive HSE bootstrap bounds against both controls. Audit M9 with the same stability rule.
experiments.success_criteria: Strict four-metric gate plus preregistered stability; select the lowest RMSE eligible candidate. No test scoring.
experiments.observation: 50of3645 strict four-metric passes;31pass fold stability. Seven candidates rejected for uncertain event intervals; the eighth qualifies: RMSE78.00, Fisher r0.574, chi-square26.56, HSE_TS0.249. Positive event-score intervals against both controls and3/4 fold-stability checks. Recovered controls and row audits exactly match originals. Operational failures retained.

experiments.label: F2
experiments.title: Frozen stability-qualified location model on original WindNet folds
experiments.hypothesis: The training-only stability-qualified M10 primary may improve all four original metrics on identical historical windows.
experiments.method: Freeze all scientific sources, recipes, epochs and data identities; then one original five-fold pass with seven fixed models/ablations plus released WindNet. Fit all before scores are exported. No label access by estimators or post-test model replacement.
experiments.success_criteria: Strictly lower mean-fold RMSE and reduced chi-square, higher Fisher-z correlation and mean original HSE threat score versus released WindNet on2198identicalwindows. Undefined fails.
experiments.observation: Frozen source/recipe identity57db805d21920576fd18f5ce46069aee2b81dc5a5771f7f28b8ba1e0dc61131f. Seven model recipes and all epochs/weights locked beforeFold5access. Training-only selection complete; one fixed historical comparison running.
